observations: Original reads clearly as a small blank blue-slate board inside yellow-orange wood, with two short feet; this identity and palette family are appropriate.

Original top rail is a very bright broad strip, side rails have abrupt planar changes, and lower feet become deep brown with weak readable volume. At logical scale the construction reads as stacked slabs.

Fixed target expresses warm honey-orange wood, rounded rail volumes, legible end caps, framed inset slate and small crafted joint accents. These are useful native design opportunities rather than exact topology requirements.

Target retains a calm dark blue writing face. Its painted grain and glints convey warmth, but their exact painted strokes, exaggerated white highlights, alpha speckles and outer glow are not requirements.

At comparable visible-art height the target keeps recognizable framing, support separation and a quiet usable face. Initial QA sheet shows the original at exact 192x352 logical frame and target solid-art bbox uniformly height-fit only; the target fit is aesthetic evidence, never registration proof.

rankedDesiredOutcomes.location: wood frame, caps and lower supports
rankedDesiredOutcomes.effect: Current slab construction feels rigid and generic compared with the crafted target.
rankedDesiredOutcomes.desiredOutcome: Useful rounded native construction with readable coherent joints/supports and purposeful restrained detail, while preserving the functional display and envelope.

rankedDesiredOutcomes.location: top rail highlight and dark lower feet
rankedDesiredOutcomes.effect: Bright upper strip and dark foot blocks interrupt softly lit volume.
rankedDesiredOutcomes.desiredOutcome: Soft coherent edge highlights and warm midtone-to-shade transitions; feet and joints remain readable without black dead spots or blown strips.

rankedDesiredOutcomes.location: wood/slate material distinction at game scale
rankedDesiredOutcomes.effect: Large flat regions provide little tactile character beyond basic color.
rankedDesiredOutcomes.desiredOutcome: Wood and inset slate have restrained, stable material character that survives logical scale without noisy texture or intrusive display decoration.
